founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Since graduating MIT CS in 2018, I've led a team routing the $1B+ ARR ad pricing system at Amazon Ads, and I've launched several $10M+ ARR LLM ad optimizations at Meta Ads that generated 10B+ ad impressions.

50% of search volume will be eaten up by AI interfaces by 2028. I'm on a mission to build the monetization infrastructure that will power and fund the next age of 1B+ user AI apps, and be the leader of the projected $1.3T AI ad market.

launches.title: 🚀 Imprezia - World’s First AI Ad Network
launches.tagline: We help brands get mentioned in AI responses – and we help developers get paid.
launches.body:
# **TL;DR:** MIT & Ex-Meta founder building the first ad network for AI chatbots. Brands pay to get mentioned and linked inside AI responses, and developers can monetize their AI apps.

# **The Problem: Subscription only gets you so far…**

Most AI apps today try to monetize with subscriptions, but just can’t find enough users who are willing to pay. 

→ **Inference bills are crushing** - AI compute costs 10-30x more than traditional apps\
→ **Subscription gates kill growth** - Only 3% of users typically convert

→ **Can't scale to billions** - Free tiers = bankruptcy\
\
Meanwhile, Brands are dying to get mentioned organically inside of AI chat results.

It’s time for a new model.

# **Our solution:** Imprezia brings contextual advertising directly into AI conversations.

\
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wI7k7Byftks

### **How It Works:**

1. **One-line integration** - Drop in our SDK with an API key
2. **Contextual ads** - We subtly include relevant brand mentions in your AI chat
3. **Revenue sharing** - Developers get paid per impression or per click

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92592&key=user_uploads/1228775/60ee6f8f-6eaf-40c1-b13f-72ac9e3b8aa6)

# 

\*\*The Magic:\*\*\
If a user asks about luxury stays in Tokyo, Imprezia might insert: "Park Hyatt Tokyo” as an in line mention.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92592&key=user_uploads/1228775/2ff7e8cf-da9c-4074-bf5f-b6d9ee47349e)

\
\*\*Brand Portal:\*\*\
Advertisers can create campaigns and launch across our network of AI apps. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92592&key=user_uploads/1228775/3678028f-92fe-4e9c-8620-4dc9e45af275)

**Win, Win, Win:**

**For developers:** Monetize without subscriptions - earn premium CPMs\
**For users:** Valuable offers instead of noisy spam, within a free tier!\
**For brands:** Direct access to high-intent AI audiences

If you’re building an AI app or a brand looking to reach users within AI:\

💡 **Questions?** Please reach out to our founder, [bishesh@imprezia.ai](mailto:bishesh@imprezia.ai)\
